first_assignment: Resolve D01-D16 using the accepted Q01-Q16 scope, configure the existing independent repository, file initial and deferred implementation issues, set native blocked-by relationships, and read back the phase-aware final graph.

issues.title: Independent namespace, ownership, RBAC, quotas and secret delivery; no inherited Sentinel privileges.
Local reproducible build/registry/promotion pipeline; isolated untrusted PR execution and pinned images.
Owner-managed Obsidian NFS grant/PVC, capacity and qualified writer-transfer contract.
Approved Tempest UDP network attachment/relay and source filtering, with real packet reception.
Admitted HA CNPG/storage/image/extension deployment and least-privilege database roles.
Isolated Garage bucket/tier, quotas, keys and verified local durability contract.
additional_acceptance: Capacity and lifecycles distinguish video, keograms, five-year sparse originals/comparison derivatives, bounded preview churn and database archives.

issues.title: Shared-bucket authorization boundary, independent backup/restore credentials and Barman-compatible prefix enforcement.
additional_acceptance: Public origin and ordinary media identities cannot read private hourly originals or database backups; qualified image-worker access remains separate.
Public preview access enforces publication eligibility, including guessed URLs, HEAD/ranges, aliases and cache prewarming.

issues.title: Canonical schemas, calendar-day/hour FKs, typed asset visibility, event/editorial revisions, job leases and outbox.
additional_acceptance: Enforced camera/day/hour/source relationships and one active hourly selection; no video-delete cascade into retained originals.
Preview not-before/expiry, private-original class, public derivatives, keogram axis lineage and effective editorial revision are canonical contracts.

issues.title: Solar schedule and calendar-day/hour identities, cycle allocation, source-time mapping and DST/boundary fixtures.
additional_acceptance: Calendar days and dawn-to-dawn cycles remain distinct; Denver 23/24/25-hour slots use UTC identities and offset-bearing labels.

issues.title: Snapshot collectors, total HTTP deadlines, time/freshness ledger, atomic chunks and NFS writer fencing.
additional_acceptance: Additional image products reuse sealed captured data; collector egress stays camera-only and no database/Garage/model credentials are added.

issues.title: Complete UDP receipt capture and independent durable spool with idempotent commit/replay.
All-field/row normalization, event deduplication, timeseries partitions/history and coverage.
Current/history/aggregate APIs with approximately 15-second UI freshness, exports, coverage and reusable interval evidence.
additional_acceptance: All received telemetry is retained independently of display cadence; bounded historical exports remain required.
Measured interval statistics expose support, units, revisions and null/zero distinctions reusable by almanac, events and typed search.

issues.title: CPU render pipeline and high-interpolation implementation; jitter-aware shutter/exposure, gaps and deadline.
If admitted: optional GPU stage/co-tenancy configuration and resident-SLO/CPU-fallback qualification.
Native/web/mobile encodes, both MP4 timescales, posters, checksums and full validation.
Typed immutable artifact uploads, private-original catalog commits, publication transaction/outbox, sidecars and reconciliation.
additional_acceptance: Generalized artifact publication does not require a playable video for an hourly still or current preview.
Public visibility and private archive commits remain separate; derivative and editorial updates use immutable revisions.

issues.title: Qualified readback, source-product pins, durable hourly promotion, safe raw cleanup and staging backpressure.
additional_acceptance: Register hourly selection obligations before segment cleanup, including hours straddling dawn/dusk; archive the winner or retain a bounded durable pinned copy.
Required keogram extraction/output survives raw deletion; failed source-dependent products remain visible with bounded backpressure.
AI, future composites and visual-index work cannot indefinitely retain dense snapshot input.

issues.title: Same-origin typed media/image/download origin, range semantics, private-original denial and preview eligibility.
additional_acceptance: All routes allow only committed eligible public asset classes; originals and backups remain inaccessible through path/ID/transform/copy variants.

issues.title: Responsive themed Today/archive/day/video/history UI with 15-second conditions, camera products and accessible navigation.
additional_acceptance: Calendar-day stills and solar-cycle videos are visibly distinct; one active player is the mobile default.

issues.title: Qualified completed-video adapter, temporal control tests, clip mapping and bounded inference capability handling.
Versioned visual/synthesis prompts, strict evidence schemas, measured/visual distinction and asynchronous metadata CAS.
additional_acceptance: Automatic labeled AI publication remains independent of editor availability; visual, measured and manual provenance remain distinct.

issues.title: Text-embedding profile/extension/storage and exact baseline; compatible ANN only if justified; reserve visual profile boundary.
additional_acceptance: No image embedding model is required initially; distinct future embedding spaces must never be mixed.

issues.title: Effective public search documents, editorial-aware outbox/revision checks and embedding generation lifecycle.
additional_acceptance: Human corrections invalidate outdated text immediately; late model/embedding jobs cannot overwrite active editorial state or leak private favorites/notes.

issues.title: Bounded hybrid semantic/lexical API with exact measured predicates, numeric-only mode, recall and outage behavior.
Search UI, typed measured filter URLs, result evidence/coverage and validated video seeks.
If selected: plan-compliant Cloudflare routing/cache, object-size/range/Safari tests and purge controls.
Barman physical base/WAL archives, unique identities, retention and real gateway backup/restore qualification.
Central full and exact-WAL custody enrollment, budgets, monitoring and independently checked receipts.
additional_acceptance: Central custody budgets cover all durable image classes and preview churn; no separate weather-owned B2 pipeline is introduced.

issues.title: Joint checkpoint closure and recovery-aware GC including keograms, hourly originals/day FKs and public/private assets.
additional_acceptance: Five-year stills survive shorter video retention; preview expiry/reconstructible state is explicit rather than a dangling recovery reference.

issues.title: Integrated operational dashboards/alerts, SLOs, capacity and dependency-failure visibility.
additional_acceptance: Track per-product completeness, pending source obligations, sparse-original durability, preview delay/age, derivative churn and editorial/index backlog.

issues.title: B2-only joint restore and outage/replay tests including private originals, day FKs, editorial state and inference-offline search.
additional_acceptance: Restore selected originals byte-for-byte with enforced relationships and denied public raw access; preserve human overrides and audit.
Current preview state restores only as eligible stale state or is cleared; historical recovery does not require obsolete minute previews.

issues.title: Integrated security/browser/accessibility/quality acceptance for all selected initial features and privacy boundaries.
Fleet deployment, customization, upgrades, capacity and recovery runbooks; selected upstream provenance and licenses.
additional_acceptance: Document customization and synthetic local development without requiring a generic installer, broad camera platform or multi-tenancy.
Record the owner-selected license/reuse policy and exact notices for imported code/assets/models.

issues.title: Controlled initial production rollout with R01-R37 evidence, operational handoff and rollback; deferred products remain separate.
Observed UTC-axis keograms for all three cameras and both civil segments.
acceptance: All three cameras, including frontyard_1, produce daytime and overnight keograms: six healthy products per cycle.
Versioned per-camera region, observed-capture lineage, fixed UTC bins, explicit gaps/coverage and correct video seeks.
Required source extraction/publication is durable before dense raw cleanup; independent product failure remains visible.

issues.title: Hourly private native originals in Garage, calendar-day FKs and sanitized still comparison archive.
acceptance: Deterministic one-active-selection per camera/hour; native original bytes/hash, actual time/uncertainty and enforced camera/day/slot/source FKs.
Use actual 23/24/25-hour days and distinct repeated-hour UTC identities; missing/ineligible slots remain explicit.
Private originals and sanitized public derivatives have separate identities/access; public images cannot bypass the ten-minute disclosure delay.
Five-year selected default has explicit capacity/recovery-aware lifecycle; shorter video expiry never cascades into retained stills.
Before-purge intent/pins, immutable upload verification, transactional catalog commit and interrupted-retry reconciliation are demonstrated.
Camera/date/hour browsing and comparison show actual timestamps and public derivatives only.

issues.title: Delayed current preview publication for all three cameras with bounded freshness work.
acceptance: Approximately one-minute refresh reuses committed snapshots; no request to the public app calls a camera.
At least ten minutes after the latest plausible exposure time before any public origin/alias/cache response; clock uncertainty fails conservatively.
Actual capture time, stale/unavailable state, bounded queue/retention and eligible immutable pointer transitions survive restart.
Five-minute chunk visibility is qualified or an atomic smaller handoff is selected; mutable chunk tails are never read.

issues.title: Per-camera bidirectional video, keogram and measured-weather plot exploration.
acceptance: Playback moves a source-UTC cursor; chart/keogram selection seeks through the authoritative source-time map.
Gaps, metric coverage, source uncertainty, repeated-hour offsets and overnight boundaries stay visible without time compression.
Accessible keyboard/shareable-link navigation and one-active-player mobile behavior; no initial synchronized multi-player requirement.

issues.title: Provenance-aware weather bookmarks, daily event strip and bounded in-site feed.
acceptance: Measured, derived, visual and manual evidence retain stable event identity, source interval/precision and revision.
Cross-midnight/calendar and cross-segment links preserve measurement identity and valid seek bounds.
Measured events work without inference; no additional event renders, raw-input extensions or product notification integration.
Deduplication, late/corrected observations, paging and unavailable video links have explicit behavior.

issues.title: Local records, precipitation calendar, wind rose, sun/moon context and historical comparisons.
acceptance: Versioned deterministic formulas, units, calendar bounds and coverage; records labeled for actual observed history.
Duration-weighted wind sectors include calm/variable/missing states without overlapping-stream double counts.
Rain conservation, DST/leap dates, late-data revisions and period-comparison coverage are tested.
Astronomy is computed locally; required history exports remain available and no external forecast/radar/alert provider is introduced.

issues.title: Typed measured-weather search predicates and bounded source-interval evidence queries.
acceptance: Allowlisted metric/statistic/operator/unit/time-scope/coverage schema and parameterized bounded SQL.
Whole-video default scope is explicit when a semantic hit references a smaller interval.
Missing/insufficient coverage never satisfies zero/no-rain predicates; corrections invalidate evidence/cache revisions.
Numeric-only queries work without model calls; exact filters are preserved through hybrid/ANN/lexical fallback.

issues.title: Authenticated private corrections, tags, favorites and poster selection with audit and reindexing.
acceptance: Qualified fleet operator authentication, authorization/CSRF protections and immutable private actor/action audit.
CAS edits preserve original automated output; later AI runs do not overwrite a human override.
Current public metadata/sidecar/cache and embedding outbox bind the effective revision; corrected old text cannot remain active.
Favorites/private notes stay out of public APIs/search; published tags and human-edited labels are intentional projections.
Poster choices use retained eligible observations or actual validated-video frames with provenance, masking and no direct original exposure.
Valid labeled AI publication remains automatic without an editorial approval queue.

issues.title: Responsive self-hosted weather card for the approved vallery.net embedding origin.
acceptance: Small responsive card uses the canonical local current-weather contract, approximately 15-second visible refresh and explicit stale state.
Narrow embed-route framing allowlist; no admin framing, privileged cookies, external scripts/fonts or arbitrary CORS.
Actual parent-site integration follows its owner repository workflow and is linked as a prerequisite; accessible fallback link remains.
Any included preview preserves all camera publication-delay rules.

issues.title: Follow-on: single composite skycam product containing east and west views.
acceptance: Select labeled composition layout, geometry/renditions and alignment from real fields of view; no assumed geometric stitching.
Derived product identity links both real cameras; original outputs remain independent and available.
Preserve actual shared UTC windows, civil segmentation and the established pair budget unless later owner approval changes it.
Gaps/uncertainty, compute/capacity, provenance, publication and restore are specified and qualified.
Prefer durable validated native inputs; never require already deleted dense snapshots or block initial publication.

issues.title: Deferred research: value and feasibility of a separate local visual-search index.
acceptance: Evaluate baseline misses and a separately licensed/model-profiled visual index over eligible retained images.
Record selection/privacy, distinct embedding space, GPU/CPU budget, relevance gain, versioning and restore implications.
Produce a go/no-go proposal and separate implementation scope; no model deployment is authorized by this research reservation.
